content:
Let the increase in average age be \(2\) years (the stated increase).  
The total age of the replaced doctors is  
\[
21+23+25+27=96.
\]
The total age increase for 20 men is  
\[
20\times 2=40.
\]
So the total age of the four new engineers is  
\[
96+40=136.
\]
Thus their average age is  
\[
\frac{136}{4}=34.
\]

\[
\boxed{34}
\]
